resources.name: ABINIT

access.notes: Open-source DFT code. Troullier-Martins pseudopotentials for B, N, Mg are available via the site.

resources.notes: Used for all DFT and DFPT calculations (ground state, response functions, phonons, elastic constants).

access.notes: Reference: Mironov et al., Acta Crystallogr., Sect. C 58, i95 (2002). Space group R-3m, a_rh = 7.4096 Å, α_rh = 43.539°. Agent can download the CIF or build the unit cell from the published data.
